reason: NoName057(16) is a pro-Russian hacker group that first emerged in March 2022 and claims responsibility for cyber-attacks on government bodies, critical infrastructure, and private companies of Ukraine, the United States of America and Member States. NoName057(16) uses the DDoSia toolkit, through which it conducts denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks by repeatedly issuing network requests to target websites. Following those attacks, the group claims responsibility for those attacks, addresses targets and issues threats on the dark web or through Telegram channels. NoName057(16) is engaged in cyber-attacks with a significant effect which constitute an external threat to the Union or its Member States. NoName057(16) has targeted services necessary for the maintenance of essential social and economic activities and critical state functions of Member States, including governmental portals, military intelligence services, political parties and candidates during electoral processes, the energy and industrial sector, transport infrastructure, water supply facilities, banks, financial institutions and online payment services, and national post offices. NoName057(16) is therefore responsible for cyber-attacks with a significant effect which constitute an external threat to Member States. NoName057(16) is also responsible for cyber-attacks with a significant effect against third States.
